component.name: AverQel
component.summary: AI workspace for documents, grounded answers, agent workflows, and team messaging

description.p: AverQel is an AI workspace for document management and search, source-grounded questions, DeepSpace conversations and agent workflows, configurable model providers, approved connected apps, Qel Connect shared spaces and messaging, feedback and support, and tenant-aware security and administration. Provider and app integrations require configuration; Qel Connect is experimental beta.
